output_list.reason: The mintlvlToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initial supply is set to the owner, but there is no check to prevent overflow during minting additional tokens. This can be exploited to increase the balance of any user, allowing attackers to steal funds.

The burnlvlToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initial supply is set to the owner, but there is no check to prevent overflow during burning tokens. This can be exploited to decrease the balance of any user, allowing attackers to steal funds.
The lend function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the total supply is exceeded, allowing attackers to overflow the total supply, causing a denial of service.
